description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Extension' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Startup' namespace. The class's 'index' method loads extension data from the database, processes each extension's code, and registers related controllers, models, libraries, templates, language files, and configuration paths specific to each extension. It is part of the startup process for dynamically loading and initializing extensions in an OpenCart e-commerce system.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Class responsible for initializing and registering extensions during system startup in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads extension data from the database and registers each extension's controllers, models, libraries, templates, language files, and configuration paths required for system operation.
